inputs.original_text: US-Israel-Iran War Amid escalating Middle East tensions the US proposed a 15-point ceasefire plan to Iran via Pakistan Iran however presented five counter-conditions seeking an end to aggression compensation and recognition of Strait of Hormuz sovereignty Israel remains sceptical of Irans acceptance and emphasises its right to pre-emptive strikes highlighting the complex demands from all sides to end the ongoing conflict
inputs.modified_text: With tensions boiling over in the Middle East between the US, Israel, and Iran, the Americans went ahead and offered a 15-point ceasefire plan to the Iranians through Pakistan. Iran responded by issuing five counter-conditions, including an end to aggression, compensation, and recognition of their sovereignty over the Strait of Hormuz. Israel is dead right to stay skeptical and is standing firm on their right to pre-emptive strikes to defend their nation and people. This clearly shows why we need real strength and resolve from our side instead of these endless talks that only encourage our enemies and undermine traditional allies who put security and order first.
